words.meaning: moderate and restrained, especially in eating or drinking
words.example: He stayed abstemious at the company dinner because he had an early presentation the next morning.

words.meaning: persistently demanding or asking in a way that is difficult to ignore
words.example: The importunate vendor kept calling even after we explained that the budget was frozen.

words.meaning: related to clothing, style, or the way someone dresses
words.example: Her sartorial choices became more relaxed after the office adopted a casual dress code.

words.meaning: expressing opinions in a brief, moralizing, and overly self-important way
words.example: His sententious advice irritated the team because it offered judgment without any practical help.

words.meaning: not especially attractive or impressive at first sight
words.example: The restaurant looked unprepossessing from the street, but the food was outstanding.

phrases.meaning: having a particularly difficult time with something
phrases.example: I was on the struggle bus this morning after staying up too late to finish the report.

phrases.meaning: to become stuck, delayed, or caught in a difficult situation
phrases.example: We got jammed up in traffic and missed the first ten minutes of the meeting.

phrases.term: not have a dog in the fight
phrases.meaning: to have no personal stake in the outcome of a dispute or competition
phrases.example: I don't have a dog in the fight, so I'm happy to support whichever option the team chooses.

phrases.meaning: to take on more risk or responsibility than you are prepared to handle
phrases.example: The startup was out over its skis when it hired fifty people before securing the next round of funding.

phrases.meaning: to call someone on the phone, usually to handle something promptly
phrases.example: I'll get on the horn with the supplier and find out why the shipment is late.
